description: Vintage addon libraries. The synced copies are committed and shipped as is (no .pkgmeta externals); Tools/validate.py pins their versions.

notes.Ace3: Copied from the committed upstream Ace3 (git HEAD), not a working copy: a locally modified Ace library would override every other addon's copy through LibStub.
notes.FenUI: UI widgets and design tokens; the Vintage themes come from Theme/VintageTokens.lua
notes.LibDeflate, LibSerialize: The bridge codec (Core/BridgeFormat). LibSerialize must be MINOR 7 or later: its stable serialization matches libs/bridge-format byte for byte. _dev_/Libs/LibSerialize is a clone of rossnichols/LibSerialize at tag v1.2.3
